<STBG 5,0><BGM 0,0,504><MWT 5>On <COL FEEB4EFF>Malakhja Island</COL> I found
a stone tablet engraved with history.

<MWT 4>It seems these isles hold legendary
relics known as ≪Relics≫.

<MWT 4>「The worn claw, by its power,
turns knowledge into wisdom.
That is the treasure.」

<MWT 4>Those are the words on the tablet
about <COL FEEB4EFF>Malakhja's relic</COL>.
